newsitem.title: USA: Providence, Wyser-Pratte file to dismiss complaint.
newsitem.headline: Providence, Wyser-Pratte file to dismiss complaint.

text.p: Providence Capital Inc and Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc said on Thursday that they had filed papers moving to dismiss COMSAT Corp's lawsuit against the businesses and against their presidents.
COMSAT charged that the privately held firms violated the Communications Satellite Act of 1962.

On Tueday, COMSAT amended its complaint to add as defendants eight of the nine individuals that Providence intended to nominate for election to COMSAT'S board, the companies said in a joint statement.

Herbert Denten, president of Providence, and Guy Wyser-Pratte, president of Wyser-Pratte, said in the statement that COMSAT's lawsuit was "a meritless sideshow that is nothing more than a bald attempt to make us and the candidates Providence has proposed for election to the board of COMSAT go away."
COMSAT previously announced that it will hold its annual meeting on August 15, the statement said.
Wyser-Pratte owns beneficially nearly three percent of COMSAT shares of common stock and Providence Capital Inc owns less than one percent of COMSAT common shares.
